card.name: Dosing-frequency abbreviations after a dose
card.fires_on: The letters inside Latin dosing-schedule abbreviations such as t.i.d., b.i.d., q3h, prn and tid, right after a dose in mg.

modes.label: Dotted abbreviations
modes.description: The d after t.i or b.i in t.i.d. and b.i.d. following a mg dose.

modes.label: Other schedule shorthand
modes.description: The q, tid or prn part of other frequency abbreviations after a dose.
